"""A subscriber to ``WorkerStartedEvent``."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, final

from typing_extensions import override
from xtr_event_dispatcher import EventSubscriberInterface
from xtr_messenger.event import WorkerStartedEvent

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from collections.abc import Mapping

    from xtr_event_dispatcher import SubscribedEvents

__all__ = ["WorkerStatsSubscriber"]


@final
class WorkerStatsSubscriber(EventSubscriberInterface):
    """Reacts to ``WorkerStartedEvent``."""

    @classmethod
    @override
    def get_subscribed_events(cls) -> Mapping[str | type, SubscribedEvents]:
        """Map each event to the method reacting to it."""
        return {WorkerStartedEvent: "on_worker_started_event"}

    async def on_worker_started_event(self, event: WorkerStartedEvent) -> None:
        """Handle ``event``."""
        del event  # Replace with what reacting to the event does.
